## 3.1.1-hermes — Initial release for Hermes Agent

Adapted from imbad0202/academic-research-skills v3.1.1 for Hermes Agent.

**Key Features:**
- 12-agent paper writing pipeline via delegate_task
- 10 modes: full/plan/outline/revision/revision-coach/abstract/lit-review/format-convert/citation-check/disclosure
- 6 paper types, 5 citation formats (APA/Chicago/MLA/IEEE/Vancouver)
- Bilingual abstracts (zh-TW + EN), LaTeX/DOCX/PDF output
- 25 reference files, 11 templates, 6 examples

**Adaptation:** All agents run through Hermes delegate_task. v3.6.6 Generator-Evaluator contracts preserved. Handoff from deep-research supported.
